title: Remotely Sensing Cities and Environments Portfolio
text:
Preface
Hello and welcome to Christy’s page on Remote Sensing. This page is an online learning diary for CASA Remotely Sensing Cities and Environments 25/26. This website contains a record of her week-by-week learnings, including summary of key concepts, practical applications, reviews on academic literature and relevant web sources, as well as reflections and discussions on learnt concepts and techniques.
